span.p:
entered from ANY state on: E-stop open, limit hit, limit wiring,
soft limit, tension high, load-cell lost, pretension timeout, home timeout,
skipped steps, heartbeat/vision timeout, FAULT_* from vision,
comm errors, guard open, STOP, local stop.
Drivers disabled; servo outputs off; position forgotten; RESET required.
